concepts.why: Secular scholar / Jewish reader of the Hebrew Bible: the name says 'do not pray', and Jeremiah 7:16, 11:14, 14:11 and 15:1 (Moses and Samuel standing before Him) say it or plainly concern intercession. Ezekiel 14:14 mentions no prayer and no intercession at all: it says Noah, Daniel and Job 'could deliver only themselves'. Placing it here has the site read prayer into it. Drop it, or let the Ezekiel 14 passage stand in a concept whose name it does say.

concepts.name: I will make a covenant
concepts.why: Reformed / Baptist-dispensational / academic readers: only Jeremiah 31:31 and Hebrews 8:8 say 'new covenant'. Jeremiah 32:40 says 'an everlasting covenant' and Ezekiel 37:26 'a covenant of peace ... an everlasting covenant'; neither says new. Under the name 'new covenant' the site asserts that these are the same covenant, which is exactly where traditions and dispensational readers part (and one a name says that two of five passages do not). 'I will make a covenant' is in the words of all five (Jer 31:33 'the covenant I will make'; 32:40; Ezek 37:26; the 'new' of Jer 31:31 and Heb 8:8 stays in their notes). If the name must keep 'new', drop Jeremiah 32:40 and Ezekiel 37:26 instead.
